name: Nonlinear animation is all you need
description: Make every GNOME animation smooth and nonlinear! Custom curves, interruptions that keep flowing, and jank fixes, all in one extension. GNOME's default animations are linear, counter-intuitive, and plain: they never speed up, never slow down, and an interrupted one snaps back to the start or re-accelerates from standstill. This one carries the current momentum through every interruption, so a redirect flows into one continuous, silky deceleration instead. If you feel that too, this extension is exactly what you need.
